# `core/memory/UniformBufferRing.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/memory/UniformBufferRing.js`

UniformBufferRing.js - Double/Triple Buffered Uniforms Prevents GPU stalls by rotating uniform buffers each frame. While GPU reads from one buffer, CPU writes to another. Benefits: - No stalls waiting for GPU to finish reading uniforms - Better frame pacing - Smoother performance Usage: const ring = new UniformBufferRing(); ring.init(device, uniformSize, 3); // Triple buffering // Each frame: const buffer = ring.getWriteBuffer(); device.queue.writeBuffer(buffer, 0, uniformData); const bindGroup = ring.getBindGroup(layout, bindings);
